name: Read member savings balance
description: Looks up a member by Member ID in the MeridianCore Member Servicing console and returns their current savings balance along with member name and status. Read-only.

inputs.name: memberId
inputs.description: The member's ID as entered in the Member Lookup form.

target.robustnessNote: Primary target is accessibility role="textbox" name="Member ID" (accessibility-first: robust to markup churn and portable to a11y trees). 2 fallback(s) provide resilience if the primary drifts.
Primary target is accessibility role="button" name="Search" (accessibility-first: robust to markup churn and portable to a11y trees). 1 fallback(s) provide resilience if the primary drifts.
Readable value: targeted by author-assigned id (value text is not used as a name because it varies per run).

runtimeRules.name: record_not_found
runtimeRules.description: Member ID does not resolve to a record.
runtimeRules.message: No member exists for the supplied member ID.

runtimeRules.name: permission_denied
runtimeRules.description: Operator lacks rights to view/act on this record.
runtimeRules.message: Access to this member record is restricted; additional authorization is required.

runtimeRules.name: validation_error
runtimeRules.message: Input failed validation (initial deposit must be a non-negative number).

runtimeRules.name: unexpected_interstitial
runtimeRules.description: An unexpected System Notice modal is blocking the flow.
runtimeRules.message: Dismissed an unexpected System Notice interstitial and continued.

runtimeRules.name: session_timeout
runtimeRules.description: Session expired; app redirected to sign-in.
runtimeRules.message: Session expired mid-flow. Re-authentication is required before this capability can complete.

runtimeRules.message: The application returned an unexpected system error (500). Aborting.

metadata.goal: look up member 12345 and read their current savings balance
